200 Returned if the AWS target list for the specified scanner was retrieved successfully.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The ID of the scanner.
string
Unique instance identifier from Amazon.
string
Private IP address of the AWS instance.
string
Public IP address of the AWS instance.
string
The state of the instance. Can be one of the following values: running ,
stopped , or terminated .
string
The availability zone for the instance. Example: us-east-1a , us-
east-1b , etc.
string
The size of the instance. Example: t2.small , t2.medium , etc.
string
The user-defined name of the instance.
scanner_id

instance_id

public_ip

zone
type
name
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view scanner data.
— 404
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified scanner, or if the scanner is
not an AWS scanner.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
